Version of the song intended for Ye and Ty Dolla $ign's album VULTURES 1, althoguh it ended up releasing on one of the deluxe editions for VULTURES 2. Considered a fake due to Bad not clearing his vocals for release. Bad was eventually replaced by Peso Pluma in the final release excluding some few ad-libs (likely uncleared). Files attached are a snippet previewed by producer SHDØW May 29th, 2024 and a briefly snippet played at the VULTURES Miami rave that was not played on the live stream for the event due to the stream having connection problems while the song was playing.This version lacks Ye vocals, however it's likely he did record for the song, as he is confirmed to have recorded to every song on one of the VULTURES 1 tracklist that included this song. Filename shared by VEYIS on Instagram, saying it was one of his favorite songs he produced.
